build_ball_shape: build a ball shape with a given radius using Ball.build(radius=10)
build_box_shape: build a box shape with specified width and height using Box.build(width=20, height=10)
build_bar_shape: build a bar shape with a given width using Bar.build(width=30)
build_standing_sticks_shape: build standing sticks shape with angle and width using StandingSticks.build(angle=77.5, width=20, height=5)
build_jar_shape: build a jar shape with height, width, thickness using Jar.build(height=20, width=15, thickness=3, base_width=12)
get_shape_builders: get a dictionary mapping builder names to ShapeBuilder subclasses using get_builders()
compute_polygon_centroid: compute the center of mass and mass of a convex polygon using compute_polygon_centroid(vertices)
compute_shape_diameter: compute the diameter of a shape object using compute_shape_diameter(shape)
check_convex_polygon: check if points form a valid convex polygon in counter-clockwise order using is_valid_convex_polygon(points)
compute_union_centroid: compute center of mass of multiple polygons using compute_union_of_polygons_centroid(polygons)
